name: Minas de Riotinto (Spain)
description: Four horizontal stripes, blue of seven tenths and then white, red and white of one tenth each, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Minas de Riotinto (crossed tools on blue above red).
history: The flag of Minas de Riotinto has four stripes parallel to each other and perpendicular to the hoist, the first blue of 7/10 of the width, and the rest white, red and white of 1/10 each.

features.role: Minas de Riotinto arms — crossed tools on blue above red
